# Alessandro Gentili

Alessandro Gentili is an author and strategist working across writing, editorial architecture, AI systems and civic interpretation.

Main areas of the site:
- Saggi
- Metodo / AI
- Portfolio

- Contatti

Contact email: contatti@alessandro-gentili.it
Privacy email: privacy@alessandro-gentili.it

Editorial essay system:
- The essay archive is the structured editorial home for local essay landing pages.
- Local essay landing pages provide abstracts, context, selected short excerpts and links to Medium without duplicating full essays.
- Main archive: https://alessandro-gentili.it/saggi.html
